ja: 予算無制限なら、どんな製品を作りたいですか？
en: If money were no object, what would you build?
alternatives: What would you build if money were no object?
If budget weren't an issue, what would you build?
point: 仮定の話なので if 節は過去形 were、主節は would

ja: 転勤があっても、私は御社に長く勤めたいです。
en: Even if I'm transferred, I'd like to stay long-term.
alternatives: Even with a transfer, I'd like to stay long-term.
I'd like to stay long-term, even if I'm transferred.
point: Even if の後は現在形。I'd like to で控えめに。

ja: 学生のうちに英語を勉強しておけばよかった。
en: I wish I'd studied English as a student.
alternatives: If only I'd studied English as a student.
I wish I had studied English while in school.
point: 過去への後悔は wish の後を had + 過去分詞にする

ja: 前は営業でしたが、その後、採用に転向しました。
en: I was in sales, but I've since pivoted to recruiting.
alternatives: I was in sales before, but I've switched to recruiting.
I used to work in sales, then switched to recruiting.
point: 過去の話と今に続く話は was と I've で分ける

ja: 御社のことは、事前に調べてきました。
en: I read up on your company beforehand.
alternatives: I looked into your company beforehand.
I did some research on your company.
point: 「調べる」は read up on / look into などの句動詞

ja: 彼女は今、転職先を探しています。
en: She's looking for a new job.
alternatives: She's job hunting right now.
She's currently looking for a new job.
point: 今している最中のことは is looking と進行形で

ja: 私は人と話すのが好きです。
en: I enjoy talking with people.
alternatives: I like talking to people.
I love speaking with people.
point: enjoy の後ろは to 不定詞ではなく -ing 形

ja: この仕事、技術より対話力が大切ですか？
en: Is communication more important than technical skill here?
alternatives: Does communication matter more than technical skill here?
Is communication more important than tech skills here?
point: 「AよりBが大切」は B is more important than A

ja: チームをまとめた経験で、納期を守る術を学びました。
en: Having led a team, I've learned to hit deadlines.
alternatives: Leading a team taught me how to meet deadlines.
After leading a team, I've learned to meet deadlines.
point: 「〜した経験から」は Having + 過去分詞で文頭に置く

ja: 私は新しい市場を開拓した経験があります。
en: I have experience opening up new markets.
alternatives: I have experience developing new markets.
I've opened up new markets before.
point: have experience + -ing（of も可）。「開拓する」は open up

ja: どうしてうちの会社を選んだんですか？
en: Why did you choose our company?
alternatives: Why did you pick our company?
What made you choose our company?
point: did の後ろは choose（原形）で chose にしない

ja: 強みを教えてください。
en: Tell me about your strengths.
alternatives: Please tell me about your strengths.
Please tell me your strengths.
point: tell me about ～ で「～について教えて」

ja: 採用されたら、顧客と信頼を築きます。
en: If I'm hired, I'll build client trust.
alternatives: If you hire me, I'll build client trust.
If hired, I'll build trust with clients.
point: 未来のことでも if 節は現在形の受け身 I'm hired

ja: 彼女の経験は、まさに私たちが求めているものです。
en: Her experience is exactly what we're looking for.
alternatives: Her background is just what we need.
She has exactly the experience we're after.
point: 「求めているもの」は what we're looking for。for を残す

ja: 御社サイトで募集中の職種に興味があります。
en: I'm interested in the position posted on your website.
alternatives: I'm interested in the role advertised on your website.
I'm interested in the job posted on your site.
point: 「募集中の」は posted など過去分詞で後ろから名詞を修飾

ja: 経験は浅いですが、学ぶのは早いです。
en: Though my experience is limited, I learn fast.
alternatives: Even though I have little experience, I learn fast.
I may lack experience, but I learn fast.
point: Though は「〜だが」。but と二重にしない

ja: 私は大阪でエンジニアをしています。
en: I'm an engineer in Osaka.
alternatives: I work as an engineer in Osaka.
I'm an engineer based in Osaka.
point: 職業を言うときは an engineer と冠詞をつける

ja: 御社のチームに貢献するのが楽しみです。
en: I'm looking forward to contributing to your team.
alternatives: I can't wait to contribute to your team.
I'm excited to contribute to your team.
point: look forward to の to は前置詞なので、あとは -ing 形。

ja: 一番速くはなくても、私は丁寧に仕事をします。
en: Even if I'm not the fastest, I'm thorough.
alternatives: Although I'm not the fastest, I'm thorough.
I may not be the fastest, but I'm thorough.
point: Even if の後は現在形。not the fastest と最上級に the を付ける

ja: 3年目に、チームのリーダーを任されました。
en: I was made team leader in my third year.
alternatives: I was asked to lead a team in year three.
In year three, I became the team leader.
point: 「任された」は受け身。was made / was asked to

ja: これまで培った粘り強さが、私の強みです。
en: The persistence I've built up is my strength.
alternatives: My strength is the persistence I've built up.
The tenacity I've developed is my greatest strength.
point: 「培った粘り強さ」は persistence の後ろに I've built up と置く

ja: 前の上司は新人にも大きな仕事を任せてくれました。
en: My old boss let newcomers handle big projects.
alternatives: My last manager let new hires take on big projects.
My previous boss allowed newcomers to handle major projects.
point: let + 人 + 動詞の原形。to を入れない

ja: 期待される成果を伺ってもよろしいですか？
en: May I ask what results you expect?
alternatives: Could I ask what results you're expecting?
Could I ask what results are expected?
point: ask の後は what you expect の語順。do you にしない

ja: 今思えば、辞める前に上司と話すべきでした。
en: In hindsight, I should've talked to my boss first.
alternatives: Looking back, I should have spoken with my boss first.
I should have talked to my boss before quitting.
point: 過去への後悔は should have + 過去分詞

ja: 英語と中国語が話せます。
en: I can speak English and Chinese.
alternatives: I speak English and Chinese.
I speak both English and Chinese.
point: can の後ろは動詞の原形 speak

ja: 前の会社が撤退しなければ、転職しなかったでしょう。
en: If my firm hadn't pulled out, I wouldn't have left.
alternatives: I wouldn't have left if my old company hadn't withdrawn.
Had my company not pulled out, I'd never have left.
point: 過去の反対は if + had 過去分詞、主節は would have 過去分詞

ja: 上司に推薦してくれるよう頼みました。
en: I asked my boss to vouch for me.
alternatives: I asked my boss to recommend me.
I asked my manager to vouch for me.
point: ask + 人 + to do。「頼む」は ask 人 to 動詞の形

ja: あの失敗こそが、今の私をつくったんです。
en: It's that failure that made me who I am.
alternatives: That very failure made me who I am.
It was that failure that shaped who I am today.
point: It's A that ~ で A を強調する。
